data.outcome_summary: This OECD PISA 2022 Volume III factsheet summarizes Spain’s performance on the PISA 2022 Creative Thinking cognitive test for 15-year-old students. The creative thinking assessment measures three ideation processes—generating diverse ideas, generating creative ideas, and evaluating and improving ideas—across four domain contexts: written expression, visual expression, social problem solving, and scientific problem solving. Spain’s mean creative thinking score is 33 out of 60, on par with the OECD average. The factsheet reports that 80% of students reach at least Level 3 (baseline proficiency) and 25% are top performers at Levels 5–6. It also highlights within-country relationships: creative thinking is positively correlated with mathematics (0.59) and reading (0.59), and socio-economic status, gender, and several beliefs/attitudes and school environment indicators are associated with creative thinking performance. The document is descriptive and does not provide an ML modeling pipeline or PV/missing-data procedures.
